items.title: Claude 앱: Personal Finance in Claude
items.body: We’re rolling out Personal Finance, a beta that lets you link your bank, credit card, loan, and investment accounts to Claude, so you can see your balances and spending on one page and ask Claude questions about your own money. It's available on Pro, Max, and Ultra plans, and is available in the US only. For more information, see our blog post: Introducing Personal Finance in Claude .
